description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which implements the main home screen for an Android TV app. The fragment manages UI components such as top navigation, banners, and content rows, using RecyclerViews with horizontal and vertical layouts. It employs mock data for banners and content, sets up focus behavior suitable for TV navigation, and includes styling and accessibility features.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing a media content item with ID, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content with a title and list of ContentItems.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Object providing static mock data generation functions for ContentItems.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components: brand, top navigation, banner, and content rails.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Configures the brand text with styled spans and accessibility label.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation RecyclerView with categories and focus handling.

methods.name: setupBannerRail
methods.description: Configures banner RecyclerView with mock banners, snap behavior, and focus management.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Initializes the vertical list of content rows with mock data and focus behavior.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears view binding reference on fragment destruction.
